name: cacert-2026-10-20
purpose: The root certificates of the system layer (plan step W3.1): Mozilla's CA bundle as curl's project extracts it from the NSS store, one PEM file by its SHA-256, which the .NET install lays at /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, where System.Security.Cryptography's root store on Unix reads every file of /etc/ssl/certs and OpenSSL's default directory under /etc/ssl lies. The bundle is under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, which its header states and setup requires; a later extract replaces the pin whole.
